thread:
Anna (Sales): FYI inbound SIG/CAIQ from VentureVault. They've put a hard deadline on the RFP - need answers by Tue EOD. Link: https://drive.company/VV-SIG-2026.pdf 
Jordan (Security): Thanks - can you drop the scope? Which deployment mode are they planning (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)?
Anna (Sales): Primary ask is hosted API but they want options for Dedicated and VPC later. Also questions about BYOK/KMS and data retention.
Mike (PreSales): Happy to own the questionnaire answers. Quick ask: do we have a recent SOC2 + pen test report to attach?
Sam (Eng): We have SOC2 report from Q4 2025 in the secure repo. Pen test is from July 2025 - permissions are limited, I'll push a sanitized copy to the drive.
Jordan (Security): Great. For Q23 (encryption at rest) we should state the standard: "AES-256 at rest; customers can request Dedicated or Private for BYOK/HSM integration". Also note KMS integrations: AWS KMS, GCP KMS, and coming HSM via enterprise onboarding.
Anna (Sales): Do we want to claim BYOK immediately or mark as "available with Private / Dedicated + legal OK"? Customer is Enterprise finance, they might insist on BYOK.
Mike (PreSales): Let's be clear: Hosted = no BYOK; Dedicated = customer-controlled KMS in our DC? Better to say: "Customer KMS supported for Dedicated/Private with onboarding". Avoid saying Hosted supports BYOK.
Jordan (Security): Agreed. Also they asked about network isolation diagrams. Sam - can you export a simple VPC diagram and a one-pager on routing + egress controls?
Sam (Eng): On it. Will produce a .png + short bullet list. ETA Monday noon PT.
Anna (Sales): Awesome. I'm going to set expectation with the customer: draft answers by Mon EOD, final package Tue morning.
deploy-bot: Deploy reminder: please ensure any shared reports are scrubbed of internal IPs before uploading.
Jordan (Security): Also adding a note for evidence: we should include (1) SOC2, (2) Pen test summary, (3) Network diagram, (4) Data flow for PII, (5) Encryption statement.
Mike (PreSales): I'll start filling the sig doc. Quick stub for Q45 (data retention): "Data retained per customer config; default is 30 days logs, 90 days metadata; customer can request longer retention under contract." Thoughts?
Jordan (Security): Sounds fine, add note: "Can be configured via contract; audit logs retained per SOC2 policy."
Anna (Sales): Who's the owner for the questionnaire? I can coordinate customer calls, but need SME for technical clarifications.
Jordan (Security): I'll be technical owner for security controls. Mike will be answers owner for operational questions. Anna - please own the submission and timeline.
Anna (Sales): Assigned. I'll book a short sync with the customer and include Jordan + Mike. Suggested times Tue 1pm or Wed 10am PT - which works for you both?
Mike (PreSales): Tue 1pm PT works for me.
Jordan (Security): Wed 10am PT is better for me; can we do Tue 1pm if needed but prefer Wed.
Anna (Sales): I'll propose Tue 1pm as tentative and mention Jordan prefers Wed. Customer asked for quick turnaround, so I'll push Tue and loop everyone.
Sam (Eng): PR for the diagrams will be in the drive folder "VV-SIG-Assets". Tagging Jordan for review.
Jordan (Security): I'll review the diagram for any sensitive callouts.
Anna (Sales): Anything else? They also asked about SLAs and incident response. Should we attach our standard SLA doc and an incident response summary?
Mike (PreSales): SLA yes. Incident response: short summary + contact process (pager, email) - redact internal pager numbers.
Jordan (Security): Add the security contact as a role (Security Oncall) not a specific phone. Legal will handle formal contact info in the contract.
Anna (Sales): Cool. Plan summary: 
- Owner: Anna (submission)
- Tech owner: Jordan (security controls)
- Answers owner: Mike (ops/pss)
- Artifacts: SOC2, pen test, network diagram (Sam)
- Timeline: Draft -> Mon EOD, Final -> Tue morning
I'll post updates to this thread and upload to the drive folder.
Mike (PreSales): I'll start the draft now and tag Jordan for any control language.
Jordan (Security): I'll do a security pass on the answers Mon morning.
Anna (Sales): Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll ping again after I get confirmation from the customer on the meeting.
Sam (Eng): Uploaded network diagram to VV-SIG-Assets/diagram_v1.png - ping me if anything needs redaction.
Jordan (Security): Got it. Review in progress.
Anna (Sales): Thread pinned to the sales channel for visibility.
Mike (PreSales): Noted - starting the questionnaire fill.
Anna (Sales): Closing note - customer also asked about proof of continuous training for staff (sec awareness). Jordan, do we have a 1-page training summary?
Jordan (Security): Yes - will upload a training summary and link to the LMS completion stats. ETA Mon morning.
Anna (Sales): Perfect. Thanks everyone.
